entries.basis: Eleven explicit applicability mappings link each required key family to shipped contracts/tests and actual native receipts. Appropriate native editing/link behavior is preserved rather than imposing collection shortcuts on every component.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-X-02 Reconcile original `X-02`: Define keyboard contracts and verify Tab/Shift+Tab, arrows, Home/End, Enter/Space, Escape, and typeahead where appropriate. Historical status: open.

entries.basis: Retained native coverage establishes initial/return/trapped focus, nested dismissal and focus after removal/reorder/update. The only identified current removed-opener restoration gap now passes six focused three-engine cases without mocks, forced focus or assertion changes.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-X-04 Reconcile original `X-04`: Verify initial focus, return focus, focus after removal/reorder/update, trapped focus in modals, and nested-overlay dismissal ordering. Historical status: open.

limits: Current six cases and retained historical receipts keep their distinct source/runtime scopes. Native keyboard/DOM/AX evidence does not establish spoken assistive-technology or physical-device acceptance. No all-state Cartesian promise.
